scope: Past expansion and conditional grey-luminosity history from an already qualified distinct native-accuracy2 posterior. Preparation and synthetic validation perform no physical calculations.
parent: Fresh native_accuracy_qualify.qualify_run, actual QualifiedNativeAccuracy2, numerical_accuracy=2, all2000 original slots and original untrimmed native2/proposal weights. No original accuracy1 filesystem consumer or filename substitution.
background: Exactly one CAMB get_background invocation per selected slot, shared between expansion and SN luminosity; use that slot's actual finalized native2 theory extra_args and the frozen expansion_history.native_thermal_parameters adapter. Match actual Params.max_l. No native CMB spectrum, transfer or likelihood evaluation. Repeated slots retain their original multiplicity.
physics: Unchanged flat PPF GR background, early-universe/neutrino settings, and likelihood configuration of parent. Require three accuracy boosts2. No independent stellar clock.
expansion: Reuse expansion_history.background_history, pointwise_summary and the unchanged redshift grid, finite-difference step, numerical gates and quantile probabilities from expansion-history-design.json. Compare q/j at0,.5,1,rdrag andOmega_m against native2 derived values, never native1.
SN: Only original ReleasedDistances normalized data. Full covariance, flat-M integral, zHD and zHEL factors preserved. Refuse an anchored or substituted likelihood. Recompute normalized native2 released_sn density and sn_chi2 from same background before admitting luminosity output.
luminosity: none: identically zero imposed; linear: original epsilon point times log(1+z)/log2 with no additional coefficient noise; smooth01/smooth03: recover four-coefficient conditional Gaussian under unchanged natural spline and0.1/0.3mag proper priors. Preserve coefficient and cross-redshift covariance, plus between-cosmology variance. B(0)=0 imposed. No empirical age correction.
cross_covariance: Cov(B(z),q0)=Cov_theta(E[B(z)|theta],q0(theta)); conditional coefficient scatter has zero cross-covariance with fixed-theta q0. Use stored native2 q0, checked against rebuilt background. Do not add conditional luminosity variance to this cross term.
summary: Reuse original untrimmed weighted pointwise quantiles and Gaussian-mixture inverse CDF. Apply unchanged original importance/chain/batch thresholds to all new expansion/scalar and conditional-mean luminosity histories. Conditional coefficient covariance is analytic, not a set of extra Monte Carlo samples. Failures withhold admitted histories; diagnostic status retained.
cache: New ignored directory, sealed lineage and one-use execution. Exclusive claim before each background attempt; interrupted claim cannot be retried. Complete sealed per-slot values bound to original native2 record and parent identity; final byte manifest verified before replay, never reseal changed records. Preserve known versus unknown background invocation counts. Read-only report can replay a completed cache.
qualification_limits: Pointwise model-conditional credible bands, not simultaneous bands or calibrated frequentist probabilities. Past redshifts only. Any acceleration refers only to the fixed listed grid. Cosmic age comes from the assumed CMB model. Fixed zero luminosity is a restriction, not a measurement. Finite diagnostics do not certify global numerical convergence, mode coverage, or physical adequacy.
finalized_options: The qualified native record supplies actual finalized lmax and other extra_args. Cobaya consumes halofit_version separately, so restore that declared option if absent; reject every other missing/changed declared option, except finalized lmax may exceed its pre-request value. Bind actual Params.max_l separately from padded spectrum length.
